title: All-up Q8_0 CPU-compatible ffn_up_exps pre-fallback skip correctness gate

bottleneck.component: DeepSeek decode CPU up/down fallback plus source/page behavior

prior_results.cpu_compat_boundary: max_calls=104 output-write and pre-fallback skip both passed with same_top1=145/145

candidate.name: all-up ffn_up_exps.weight CPU-compatible Q8_0 pre-fallback skip
candidate.why_this_step: Early full-layer up checks passed individually. The next correctness gate must cover every ffn_up_exps tensor before any strict cold performance benchmark can be meaningful.
candidate.theoretical_effect_if_later_promoted: This can only remove CPU fallback work for up projections. It is not expected to reach 10 tok/s alone because down fallback remains rejected; its value is to create a verified exact/token-stable up path before analyzing remaining down/source bottlenecks.
candidate.hard_upper_bound: Upper bound is strictly below the all-up+all-down removal ceiling of 11.367 tok/s. Since down remains on CPU, this step is a correctness prerequisite rather than a promotable 10 tok/s design.

command_skeleton: llama-results -m DeepSeek-V4-Flash-FP4-FP8-native.gguf -f fixed-france-text.txt --sequential-logits -c 256 -b 16 -ub 16 -t 20 -tb 20 -ngl all --fit on -fa auto --n-cpu-moe 40 --defer-experts --output baseline/result.gguf --check --top1-report top1-check.json --top1-fail-on-mismatch

correctness_gate.pass_condition: llama-results exits 0, same_top1 == n_tokens, first_mismatch_pos == -1, max_abs == 0, mean_abs == 0, and q80 skip report records only ffn_up_exps.weight tensors.
correctness_gate.failure_rule: If all-up top1 fails, do not run a performance benchmark. Record first mismatch, skip report tail, cgroup stats, then add multi-filter support or binary-search the first failing layer/record.

expected_ram_pressure: Correctness verifier reuses the existing model/result artifacts and adds only transient CUDA/Q8_0 buffers plus the skip report. It must run inside MemoryMax=16000000000 and MemorySwapMax=0; page cache remains accounted by cgroup.
expected_ttft_impact: Not evaluated in this correctness-only run. Any later strict cold performance run must satisfy TTFT <= 33617.688744 ms to be accepted.
rollback_rule: The runtime path is default-off. If correctness fails, keep source guarded/off and only commit rejected documentation/artifacts.
promotion_rule: This correctness run cannot be promoted as SOTA. It only decides whether a strict cold performance benchmark for CPU-compatible up-skip may be planned.
